criteria.effects: Mono WAV, PCM 16 bit, 48 kHz. Normalized to -22 LUFS integrated with a -1 dBTP ceiling. When reaching -22 would pass the ceiling, transition, appear, notification, error, success, impact, stinger, office and ambience sounds went through a limiter (alimiter, 2 ms attack, up to 8 dB of reduction); click and typing sounds did not, so their attack is not squashed, and they stay at the peak ceiling. The real lufs of each file is recorded: clicks are lower on purpose, because they are transients a few tens of milliseconds long. Sounds shorter than 0.5 s are measured padded with silence to 0.5 s (apad), because BS.1770 integrates in 400 ms blocks; that way they are all measured the same way and are comparable. Stingers and ambience loops follow the same rule.
criteria.music: Stereo MP3, 192 kbps, 48 kHz, normalized to -16 LUFS integrated with a -1.5 dBTP ceiling, the same reference level as the voice. The clean_loop field says whether the file loops without a click or a gap at the seam.
criteria.mix: data-volume = 10^((voice_lufs - under_voice - lufs)/20), capped at 1. voice_lufs is the measured level of the voice (gen-voice.mjs writes it to volumes.json as voice_lufs); under_voice = 15 dB for effects, 20 dB for music without a carve (with a carve, music at 1) and 30 dB for ambience. Example: voice -17, effect -23.7 -> 0.38. See references/audio-and-sfx.md.
